component.name: Miryu Toolkit
component.summary: Manage Miryu components and system-wide environment variables

description.p: Miryu Toolkit provides package helpers for optional components such as Wine, Steam, MIDI playback support and additional fonts, plus a system-wide environment variable editor for /etc/environment.
It also includes a system log collection tool that gathers system information, dnf5 logs and Anaconda installer logs into a compressed archive.

A GRUB2 boot menu configuration tool is integrated, allowing users to toggle the boot menu visibility, set the boot timeout, remember the last selected entry, and manage custom kernel parameters with polkit-protected saving.

ul.li: Merge GRUB2 boot menu configuration as a separate Boot Menu tab
Add kernel parameter management with add, edit, remove, and reorder
Rename polkit action IDs from org.miryu.toolkit to org.miryugaming.toolkit
Fix window expanding after maximize/restore cycle
Async GRUB2 save with real-time visual log dialog
Unify all polkit operations: remove close button, close log with result dialog
